## Reproducible research

My research workflow is designed to make the path from raw data to reported result as transparent as possible. Repositories listed here will document source acquisition, cleaning decisions, model specifications, diagnostics, tables, and figures.

::: {.placeholder}
**Before publishing repositories:** remove credentials and local file paths; confirm data-sharing permissions; add a license, citation file, environment lockfile, and reproducibility instructions.
:::

## Methods represented

| Area | Methods |
|---|---|
| Causal inference | Difference-in-differences, event studies, fixed effects, matching, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity |
| Time series | VAR, lag selection, impulse-response functions, forecast-error variance decomposition |
| Statistical inference | HAC and clustered standard errors, specification and robustness checks |
| Data engineering | API retrieval, panel construction, temporal aggregation, data validation, reproducible transformations |
| Communication | Quarto, LaTeX, model tables, annotated figures, research documentation |

## Data principles

I aim to publish:

1. Source descriptions and access dates
2. Retrieval and cleaning scripts
3. Variable definitions
4. Model specifications
5. Reproduction instructions
6. Known limitations

I do not redistribute restricted or licensed data. When sharing is prohibited, I provide source links and code that authorized users can run against the original source.
